timeline.body:
- [x] I carefully reed the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.

Code improvements and proguard rules for icepick (copy pasted from the [README](https://github.com/frankiesardo/icepick)).

This should fix all serviceId == -1 issues and maybe some others. The problem is that this only occurs when using the release configuration because Proguard probably removed some icepick annotation.  

This closes #744  and #749

timeline.body: IMO we don't need to check that. All the functions uses `NewPipe.getService`, which throws a self-explanatory error in the case of an non-existent service: "There's no service with the id = xx".

reply.body:
Yes the functions use this method but deferred. The exception may be thrown at any time in any thread and the calling method is not shown. 
Have a look at https://sentry.schabi.org/sentry/newpipe/issues/382/. There is no simple way to see from which fragment the serviceId is provided.
Is this PR blocked by this issue?

timeline.body: I don't mean to be rude but this bug should be fixed ASAP. Generate a bugfix release or whatever but this issue has 10 reports a day.

* `checkServiceId` is to fail faster.
 * It's clear that all saved states are not restored because IcePick is used and Proguard removes it.
